mapper.select: SELECT id, content, contact, contact_name, status, reply, created_at, updated_at FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (content, contact, contact_name, status, reply, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{content}, #{contact}, #{contactName}, #{status}, #{reply}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET content = #{content}, contact = #{contact}, contact_name = #{contactName}, status = #{status}, reply = #{reply}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
